title: Quaint Sweet Russian Pork Belly Bowl
description: A cozy, sweet and springy Russian bowl featuring char‑grilled pork belly, caramelized onions, and a subtle citrus glaze.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Place the pork belly slices in the skillet and sear until golden brown on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened and caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the brown sugar, soy sauce, and lemon juice until the mixture thickens and coats the pork and onions, about 3 minutes.
Sprinkle black sesame seeds over the mixture and toss to combine.
Transfer the contents to a heat‑proof bowl and garnish with chopped dill.
Serve immediately while hot, accompanied by a side of steamed rice or a crisp green salad.
Enjoy the comforting flavors of this sweet Russian classic.
